nodes.label: FastFusion
nodes.rationale: OpenAI-compatible API layer over Huggingface Diffusers so existing OpenAI image clients work unchanged against arbitrary diffusion models.

nodes.label: OpenAI API Compatibility
nodes.rationale: Familiar API structure chosen so users can reuse existing OpenAI SDK tooling instead of learning a bespoke interface.

nodes.label: response_format (url / b64_json)
nodes.rationale: Two delivery modes: url persists to disk for later fetch, b64_json inlines bytes and avoids storage entirely.

nodes.label: model_config.json
nodes.rationale: Single JSON file is the whole configuration surface, so deployment is a volume mount rather than a rebuild.

nodes.label: generation_presets
nodes.rationale: Named quality presets map to guidance_scale/num_inference_steps so callers request 'hd' instead of tuning raw diffusion knobs.

nodes.label: LoRA (Low-Rank Adaptation)
nodes.rationale: Modifies base-model behaviour for style/concept without retraining the full model.

nodes.label: Dynamic LoRA Loading
nodes.rationale: LoRAs are loaded once at startup but selected and weighted per request, so one loaded model serves many styles.

nodes.label: FLUX.1-Redux Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Redux extracts image embeddings that guide the main FLUX pipeline, yielding variations more faithful to the original than plain image-to-image.

nodes.label: Vision Model Automatic Prompting
nodes.rationale: When a variation request omits a prompt, a vision model describes the input image and that description becomes the prompt.

nodes.label: CPU Offloading
nodes.rationale: Trades inference speed for reduced VRAM by moving parts of the model to CPU.

nodes.label: VAE Slicing
nodes.rationale: Processes the VAE step in slices so large images fit in VRAM.

nodes.label: VAE Tiling
nodes.rationale: Breaks very high-resolution images into tiles to bound peak VRAM.

nodes.label: Split Init/Run Torch Dtypes
nodes.rationale: Separate torch_dtype_init and torch_dtype_run let loading use a wider dtype for stability while inference runs narrower for speed/VRAM.

nodes.label: Asynchronous Task Queuing
nodes.rationale: Serializes GPU work through a single worker queue so concurrent HTTP requests cannot contend for the same pipeline.

nodes.label: Automatic Image Cleanup
nodes.rationale: Background thread deletes images older than an hour so url response_format does not grow disk without bound.

nodes.label: Kubernetes Deployment Target
nodes.rationale: Stateless container plus mounted config and data volume is what makes cluster deployment straightforward.

nodes.label: BASE_URL
nodes.rationale: Required because the service must emit absolute image URLs it does not otherwise know from the request.

nodes.label: Diffusers AutoPipelines
nodes.rationale: AutoPipelineFor* classes give model-agnostic defaults; a concrete class can override when a model needs it.

nodes.label: Single Model Instance Limitation
nodes.rationale: One base model per process; serving several requires several FastFusion instances.

nodes.label: GPU Selection Limitation
nodes.rationale: Device choice is delegated to torch_device and CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES; no explicit multi-GPU allocation control.

nodes.label: Sparse Error Reporting
nodes.rationale: Model-load and pipeline failures surface tersely in API responses; detail is only in server logs.

nodes.label: diffusers (git main)
nodes.rationale: Pinned to git main rather than the released 0.36.0 (commented out), implying reliance on unreleased pipeline features.
